abilities.text: The light goes soft at the edges. You are looking, but not seeing.
It asks your name in your own voice. Something in your arm agrees with it.
Its wings keep time. Your heartbeat starts keeping it too.
Wing dust settles on your eyes like a small, kind curtain.
It says something just under hearing. Your sword hand forgets why it was raised.
The hour leans close and breathes on the lantern. The dark gets wider.
It tells you it is nearly over. It is lying in a very gentle way.
It leans over the bed you are not in. Your knees unlock first.
It tells you to put it down. The thing in your hand is very heavy now.
It holds your hand with both of its own. The cold arrives a moment later.
It cries quietly, and every sob takes something out of your swing.
Its shadow lands on you before it does. You stop being able to move.
It steps behind the trees. All the trees are behind it.
It asks you to come and see. Your eyes close so you can follow it better.
It says the water is warm. Your arms believe it.
The hour stacks on top of itself until the only sensible thing left is sleep.
The hands of it close around your ankles and do not let go.
It takes one of your hours. You feel the hole where it was.
She settles you onto a bed that has always been under you. Your eyes are already shut.
She takes a little of your warmth to keep for later. She is very careful about it.
Its hands turn inside your chest and take a share of what keeps you up.
Its face opens and something grey drifts out of it and onto your eyes.
Threads find your wrists first, then the rest of you. You are politely pinned.
The choir sings a note and something inside you answers it and leaves.
She pulls you under gently, the way a mother moves a sleeping child.
She tells you the chapel is closed. Your strength believes her completely.
The hour turns over and takes you with it. You are asleep before the other side.
It turns you over like a page and copies down everything worth keeping.
It hums the shape of a lullaby. It does not need words to work.
Something under the floor takes hold of your feet and is in no hurry at all.
It eats a mouthful of your heat. You keep standing, which is the cruel part.
You wake up, and she is already swinging. She has been waiting the whole time.
She lays a hand on your forehead and tells you it is finished. It very nearly is.
The hour stretches until your thoughts cannot reach the end of it. You stop moving.
It takes your wrists the way a clock takes a minute. Precisely. Permanently.
You open your eyes onto the grin. It swings the moment it knows you are back.
It tells you the dream is over. Your body believes that, and shuts.
It names the hour you will not wake from, and your spine believes the number.
It lets you wake up just far enough to feel the blow land.
It drinks the part of you that was still deciding whether to stand.
The light through it bends the wrong way, and your eyes lose the place it was standing.
It barks once, very quietly, and your arms remember being asleep.
It is on the ice, and then it is under it, and then it is somewhere else entirely.
It sings to the ice in a voice with no warmth in it, and the ice sings back.
It counts the shapes standing in the ice, out loud, and it never miscounts.
It turns to look at you and the fog turns with it.

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *The First Hound* remembers the world before the gates — ATK surges and a storm barrier forms!

bosses.name: The Station Warden
bosses.description: It kept a station running for a world that had already stopped. The shield it raises is the timetable, and the timetable is a weapon.

signature.name: Last Departure
signature.telegraphText: The Station Warden closes the concourse doors and reads the final timetable for *Last Departure*! _(Use .defend next turn to halve the blow!)_
signature.castText: The Station Warden announces *Last Departure* — the platform folds shut behind you!

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *The Station Warden* stops announcing arrivals at half health — ATK surges and a barrier forms!

bosses.name: The Fool's Echo
bosses.description: Two stances, always the same two. It is honest about the trick, which is the trick: knowing which one is coming is the entire fight.

signature.name: Echo of Your Own Blade
signature.telegraphText: The Fool's Echo copies your stance, a beat behind and a size larger, for *Echo of Your Own Blade*! _(Use .defend next turn to halve the blow!)_
signature.castText: The Fool's Echo returns your strike twice — *Echo of Your Own Blade*!

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *The Fool's Echo* mirrors its own overdrive at half health — ATK surges and a barrier forms!

bosses.name: The Rift Devourer
bosses.description: It eats the space between things, which is why the corridor behind it is longer every time you look. It heals in front of you because it does not think you can stop it.

signature.name: Swallow the Scenario
signature.telegraphText: The Rift Devourer opens like a page being eaten and names *Swallow the Scenario*! _(Use .defend next turn to halve the blow!)_
signature.castText: The Rift Devourer eats the floor you were standing on — *Swallow the Scenario*!

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *The Rift Devourer* is still hungry at half health — ATK surges and a barrier forms!

bosses.name: Keeper of the Last Gate
bosses.description: The gate at the top has a keeper, and the keeper has your face from before the end. It is not a copy. It is what did not come back.

signature.name: The Regression Itself
signature.telegraphText: The Keeper wears your pre-regression face and raises the gate a second time for *The Regression Itself*! _(Use .defend next turn to halve the blow!)_
signature.castText: The Keeper sends you back to the first floor and everything you learned with *The Regression Itself*!

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *Keeper of the Last Gate* regresses the fight to turn one at half health — ATK surges and a barrier forms!

bosses.name: Warden Varek, Lord of the Boiling Caldera
bosses.description: Commander of the Boiling Rock's deepest cooler, wreathed in white-hot combustion fire.

signature.name: Crimson Comet Barrage
signature.telegraphText: Warden Varek superheats the caldera air for *Crimson Comet Barrage*! _(Use .defend next turn to halve the blow!)_

enrage.text: 🔥 *OVERDRIVE!* *Warden Varek* vents the Boiling Lake — flames roar across the arena!

bosses.name: The Unagi, Leviathan of Serpent's Pass
bosses.description: Towering sea serpent whose pressurized hydro-cannon can shatter whole Fire Navy cruisers.

signature.name: Abyssal Hydro-Cannon
signature.telegraphText: The Unagi rears above the sea foam, charging *Abyssal Hydro-Cannon*! _(Use .defend next turn!)_
signature.castText: The Unagi blasts *Abyssal Hydro-Cannon* across the causeway!

enrage.text: 🌊 *OVERDRIVE!* *The Unagi* whips up a towering maelstrom around Serpent's Pass!

bosses.name: Archivist of Ten Thousand Things
bosses.description: Colossal spirit guardian of the buried library who despises mortals that misuse knowledge for war.

signature.name: Wrath of Wan Shi Tong
signature.telegraphText: The Archivist spreads vast obsidian wings to bury the hall with *Wrath of Wan Shi Tong*! _(Use .defend next turn!)_
signature.castText: The Archivist brings the dome crashing down with *Wrath of Wan Shi Tong*!

enrage.text: 🦉 *OVERDRIVE!* *The Archivist* assumes its monstrous true spirit form!

bosses.name: Vaatu's Echo, Sovereign of the High Gale
bosses.description: A primordial chaos-wind remnant coiled around the inverted spires of the Forgotten Sky Peaks.

signature.name: Harmonic Tempest Collapse
signature.telegraphText: Vaatu's Echo tears the sky open for *Harmonic Tempest Collapse*! _(Use .defend next turn!)_

enrage.text: 🌪️ *OVERDRIVE!* *Vaatu's Echo* darkens the stratosphere in violet spirit lightning!
